Start with the operating conditions.

Our site connects specific underwater tasks with the relevant Boya Gongdao equipment. It is designed to help inspection contractors and infrastructure teams define the configuration, evidence and support arrangements needed for a purchase decision.

Inspection, tunnel access, contact cleaning and sediment removal are distinct applications. Each deserves a task-specific assessment.

Three roles to identify

Manufacturer: the producer of the equipment and source of product information.

Seller: the legal entity named in the quotation and purchase agreement.

Support provider: the party responsible for each agreed technical and warranty obligation.

MANUFACTURER RELATIONSHIP

Boya Gongdao / ROBOOCEAN.

The product information and imagery on this site come from the supplied manufacturer brochures and official product pages. Manufacturer facilities, projects and credentials are attributed to the manufacturer.

Distribution scope, product availability and manufacturer support arrangements are confirmed for each project in the written proposal.
